subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should provider quota windows become automatic per-response `/usage` footer content, and if so must reply finalization consume only a preloaded snapshot rather than perform a provider lookup?
rationale: Current main lacks quota data in the reply usage contract, while prior implementations added bounded network work to final delivery; the UX, freshness, and lifecycle tradeoff requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use preloaded snapshots
options.body: Add provider-neutral quota fields to prepared reply usage state and render them only when already available, avoiding reply-time discovery or network calls.

options.title: Allow bounded reply lookup
options.body: Permit a timeout-bounded provider usage lookup during usage-enabled reply finalization and accept the possible latency and omission behavior.

options.title: Keep quotas in status surfaces
options.body: Leave provider quota windows in `/status`, CLI, and Control UI rather than adding automatic per-response display.

recommendation.title: Use preloaded snapshots
recommendation.body: Add provider-neutral quota fields to prepared reply usage state and render them only when already available, avoiding reply-time discovery or network calls.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider-usage and status history plus prior scoping on this issue make this the strongest available product and lifecycle owner.
